name: Kemal Demir
bio:
Kemal's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, sparked by a fascination with the aerodynamics of birds in flight during his youth in rural Turkey. This led him to pursue a degree in aeronautical engineering, followed by a master's specializing in computational fluid dynamics. He cut his teeth at a small but ambitious Formula 3 team, where his innovative wing designs quickly gained attention, leading to opportunities with bigger teams. His approach is methodical, yet he encourages blue-sky thinking among his team members.

Known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to extract marginal gains through subtle aerodynamic tweaks, Kemal has a proven track record of significantly improving vehicle performance. He is a firm believer in the power of simulation and data analysis, but also values real-world testing and driver feedback. Kemal's distinctive ability lies in translating complex aerodynamic principles into practical, race-winning solutions. He is a mentor to young engineers and is known for his calm demeanor under pressure.

physical.description: A man of medium height with a distinguished air, Kemal carries himself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Insists on having a specific brand of Turkish coffee brewed every afternoon at 3 PM.
Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of pacing while deep in thought, often muttering complex equations under his breath.
